$comment: Noise-averaged aggregate validation.  The sim is nondeterministic run-to-run
(same seed+PYTHONHASHSEED gives different per-seed outcomes), so single-shot
per-seed clean-counts are noise.  Here we compare 3 arms over 20 seeds each
and read AGGREGATE means: default scare vs coordinated hand-off at two priors
(0.02, 0.05) spanning the safe range.  Questions: (1) does coordination keep
voltage no worse than default while curtailing less, in aggregate; (2) do the
two priors give statistically similar aggregates (prior-independence in the
safe range, after the closed-loop changes).  Moderate priors only — the high
end (0.08/0.10) showed non-terminating control loops on some seeds.
name: vvw_aggregate
